NEW: Trump is considering another round of major strikes on Iran as Israel pushes for a four- to seven-day air campaign. 
Israel has warned that Iran is rebuilding its missile and drone arsenals and "expanding its chemical and biological weapons capabilities."
The Pentagon has presented Trump with military options targeting Iranian military and energy infrastructure, but he has yet to decide. 
U.S. officials remain divided over the intelligence and the risks of renewed fighting.
Source: NYT
